title: Dual-family functional portal-set proposer
summary: Propose a pedestrian glass entrance as one functional set using either repeated aligned door posts or paired vertical handles, rather than forcing adjacent door leaves to compete as physical target identities.

mechanisms.name: Repeated-post lattice plus paired-handle aperture
mechanisms.description: One family groups vertical segments with shared endpoints into a multi-leaf door lattice. The second pairs aligned vertical handles or posts and infers an aperture from their scale. Their ranked union preserves up to three functional portal hypotheses for active disambiguation.
inputs: Separately confirmed target-entity context before downstream admission
mechanisms.limitations: The proposer is specialized to repeated-post and paired-handle glass entrances. It does not cover stairs, open passages without vertical structure, revolving doors, shutters, or public-access state; it cannot establish target identity by itself.
